Layla Bergstrom
layla.bergstrom@example.com | Austin, TX
Layla Bergstrom has 15 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Meridian Computing (2023-2026),
where they designed a Distributed systems-backed data layer that cut p99 query
latency by 37%. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Anchor Systems
(2021-2023). Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Vertex Analytics
(2011-2021). Education: B.S. Electrical Engineering, University of Maryland,
2010. Core skills: AWS, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, REST API design, TypeScript,
Distributed systems, GraphQL, PostgreSQL.
